value.rationale: This is a natural complete connectivity/metric classification for a canonical small Steiner design at its least possible nontrivial trade size, not just an incidental count. The group-Schreier identification proves all legal minimum trades correspond to simple point permutations; the exact diameter three and intersection-to-distance law quantify whether even completely disjoint labelled designs can be connected and how efficiently, directly relevant to constrained design-reconfiguration searches. Existing known intersection possibilities and standard 840 count do not determine the geodesic table.
